programs.title: Skippy
programs.desc: Sonny takes on a job assisting a local gardener, eager to earn a little pocket money that he plans to donate to charity, showing his generosity and sense of responsibility. Meanwhile, Skippy proves once again how clever and caring she is by rallying her bushland friends to help track down a lost cat. Together, their efforts highlight both kindness and teamwork, whether through human determination or animal instinct.
